Keisha (oncall): RCA posted: https://redwood.internal/rca/3141592653 — short summary + action items below. Please read and ack when you own something. :mag:
Owen (eng-sre): TL;DR for folks: a scheduling bug in the batch router caused oversized batches to block GPU workers, increasing tail latency and dropping ~5% of batched requests for ~38m in us-east. No customer data exposure.
Priya (ops): Quick highlights for skimmers:
```
Impact window: 2026-09-02 10:12–10:50 UTC
Affected: hosted batch endpoints in us-east (~5% of batch traffic)
Root cause: batch-router allowed oversized batches when backlog spike coincided with a retry storm
Mitigation: tightened batch size caps, added backpressure on retry path at 10:40 UTC
Customer notice: draft in ops, awaiting review
```
Luca (product): Action items (owner — due):
- Owen: add a unit test for retry + backlog interaction and open PR (due 2026-09-08).
- Priya: finalize and publish external note with affected tenant guidance (due 2026-09-04 09:00 PT).
- Keisha: add a runbook section for batch-router backpressure and mitigation steps (due 2026-09-06).
- Maya: review and approve a production limit policy for max-batch-size across regions (due 2026-09-10).
AuditBot: Actions exported to tracker: https://redwood.internal/actions/3141592653 — please confirm ownership there.
Owen (eng-sre): Mitigation details: `batch.max_size=256 -> 128` and `retry.jitter=enabled` deployed 2026-09-02 10:40 UTC (deploy-id dpl-12901).
Priya (ops): Office hours to triage and sign off on external note: 2026-09-03 16:00 PT (calendar: https://calendar.internal/redwood/event/3141592653-review).
Keisha (oncall): Please react with :white_check_mark: once you've read and taken ownership of assigned items. I'll export final action list after office hours.
